name: Wireflow
tagline: Chaining a few model calls is a script, and ComfyUI already gives you a free node canvas. What you will not get in a weekend is the part after generation: a track and keyframe timeline with hosted rendering, and live multiplayer inside it. The graph is vibecodable. The editor attached to it is not.
verdictSummary: KINDA: Wireflow costs $24/mo ($288/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
